race.comment: SUPER VITALITY (6) has the right profile to be on top despite finishing ninth at Port Macquarie last start, because he blundered on jumping, gave away a big start and was only beaten just over three lengths. His previous third at Beaumont (Newcastle) came as an odds-on favourite and reads well enough for this, while Aaron Bullock adds further confidence. DEKKA'S LATEST (2) was beaten a head as favourite at Quirindi and was also close up at Moree. Has the consistency to be involved if he sees out the 1400m more effectively. DIACCETO (3) indicated he was back in great shape on resumption with a solid third over 1200m at Moree. Had excuses last start and can get off the mark quickly this time in. SILVER DREAM (10) took a clear step forward when third at Moree last start, beaten just over half a length after racing wide throughout and being bumped late. No excuses today.
